matching_criteria_en: Head of the in-house legal function (CLO / General Counsel / Head of Legal) leading lawyers; priority: regulated fintech, brokers, iGaming. Very similar roles (team lead/deputy for Head roles, broader head for Lead roles) are counted as medium; ICs only where duties clearly match.
caveats_en: Cyprus: 45 points, 30 of them are candidate expectations for our CLO vacancy in Huntflow (salary field and screening answers; amounts without net/gross are treated as net and grossed up with 2026 Cyprus tax). Russia: hh.ru CVs and vacancies, incl. legal heads at large banks.
